name: bracket_validator
short_desc: Determine whether a string of brackets is valid.
description:
Given a string `s` containing brackets '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', ']' (plus
any other characters), determine whether the bracket structure is valid.

A string is considered valid if:
  -> Open brackets are closed by the same type of bracket.
  -> Open brackets are closed in the correct order.
  -> Every closing bracket has a corresponding opening bracket.
  -> Non-bracket characters are ignored.

Function signature:
  def bracket_validator(s: str) -> bool

Examples:
  bracket_validator("()")                         -> True
  bracket_validator("()[]{}")                     -> True
  bracket_validator("{[()]}")                     -> True
  bracket_validator("")                           -> True
  bracket_validator("hello(hhhh)world{ho}w are") -> True
  bracket_validator("(]")                         -> False
  bracket_validator("([)]")                       -> False
  bracket_validator("(((")                        -> False
notes: Non-bracket characters must be ignored (treated as transparent).
